# Milestone brief — evidence-engine-spike-1

**Title:** Labeling-pace dry run — first 5 queries
**Kind:** spike
**Roadmap:** evidence-engine (plans/evidence-engine/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** ? -> 2026-07-08

## Parent epic

- evidence-engine-e1 — Fixture curation, first harness numbers, and the pinned ledger
  Build the offline static-HTML labeling report (D2-R12, wrapping server/handlers/search.py's search internals -- no new route, no server change) and use it to hand-label the 20-query graded-relevance fixture at tests/eval/fixtures/queries.json (D9-R01), producing arXMCP's first-ever make eval (dense) nDCG@5/Recall@10 numbers plus a pytest --hybrid run, committed into the PENDING tables of .claude/docs/retrieval-quality-report.md. Land the same day: a full run-manifest (embedder/chunker/tokenizer/reranker versions, fixture content-hash) appended to var/arxmcp/ops/eval/ledger.jsonl (D9-R10) so the numbers are born pinned and watchdog AC1 goes live, plus the mechanical D9-R14 rider relocating ndcg_at_k/recall_at_k/assert_threshold/_run_hybrid_against_corpus/score_and_write out of tests/eval/metrics.py into an importable package on this same harness-touching commit.

## Summary

(none in roadmap — derive scope from the acceptance criteria)

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the first 5 of the ~20 planned queries, when the owner hand-labels graded relevance for them, then actual owner-minutes-per-query is recorded and extrapolated to a full-fixture time estimate
2. Given the extrapolated total, when it exceeds ~2 owner-days, then the fixture size is cut to the smallest n that still supports D9-R02's paired-comparison math instead of letting the milestone slip again
